title: teucrium flavum subsp. glaucum
intro: Teucrium flavum subsp. glaucum, commonly known as Glaucous Germander, is a subspecies of the Germander plant, native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which have been shown to help reduce stress, improve cognitive function, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Glaucous Germander include its ability to act as a nervine tonic, a sedative, and a spasmolytic, making it useful for treating anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, diterpenes, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
